listing.name: Arthr's Pirates but EPICer - MrMagolor Edition 1.3.1 "Fool Me Not At All"
listing.summary: Gives the pirates practically every ship/weapon/fighter/hullmod in your modlist.

description:
Gives the pirates practically every ship/weapon/fighter/hullmod in your modlist.

**Warning: Will completely, semi-irrevocably, undeniably destroy your intended game progression.**

**Warning 2: If the "assign default roles to ships that do not have them" setting is enabled, it will take anywhere from a little to a lot longer to start/load a campaign, depending on your modlist size.**

Requires LunaLib

*safe to add, and probably also remove, from existing saves*
download link: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1oZ0qwVFB18zQmID66F2Llc4qZ9K4Rl3m

(attached image is spoilers for, but proves compatibility with, 0.98: IYKYK)
